'''Kett Shipping''' was a transport company that operated in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] owned by the [[Findal Kett|Kett family]]. After having great problems with local [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], they were among many companies who approached the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for help in the region, joining the company as subsidiaries. Following the Federation beginning to police the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the transportation company saw a huge increase in business.

==History==
===Origins===
Kett Shipping was a transportation company that operated in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They primarily transported ore and [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cotellier/Legends|Cotellier]] and up the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] to the planet [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. There they would pick up agricultural supplies, grain or any other goods they could make profit with back on Cotellier.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

===Troubles with pirates===
The company suffered considerable losses to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the tenure of [[Findal Kett]] as its owner. At the time of Kett's ownership, the Rseik [[Sector/Legends|sector]] had almost no [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] presence, and so piracy was rampant with no one to oppose the criminals. In one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] Kett shipping lost four of six convoys to the [[Fujari]] pirates of [[Tertiary Fujar system/Legends|Tertiary Fujar]], who ransomed back three of them and sold the fourth as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. In the following year, only one of five Kett Shipping convoys that left for Kabal returned to Cotellier. In an attempt to avoid the Fujari, Kett the diverted his convoys to travel along the [[Little Minos Run]] instead, but after several years of this another pirate group known as the [[Hajara gang]] began working out of the planet [[Corva Yag/Legends|Corva Yag]] and capturing Kett's convoys.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

In [[214 BBY]], an outbreak of the [[Bordal Contagion]] disease on the world of [[Bordal]] drew the attention of the Republic, who manufactured an [[Bordal Contagion antidote|antidote]] on the world of [[Tauber]]. Kett Shipping along with several other organizations active near Bordal sent convoys to collect and deliver the antidote. Kett Shipping's convoy never reached Bordal as it was attacked by the Fujari, which caused all six million samples of the antidote on board to be lost.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

===Agreement with the Trade Federation===
This disaster led to Kett and a large number of other local interests, including [[Rseikharhl Hullspace]], [[Cotellieri Transports Limited]] and the [[Ma'ar Shaddam Weaponsmiths Guild]], to approach the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for aid. Kett and the others arranged a secret meeting with a Trade Federation agent on the planet [[Syned]], and the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]] all parties agreed to become Federation subsidiaries. Now protecting their own interests, the Federation established a military presence in the Rseik sector and quickly destroyed the Fujari pirates, followed by the Hajari gang a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later. Within a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], thanks to the Federation's improvements in the area, Kett Shipping was successfully running twenty convoys a year to Kabal and losing none.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

===Later history===
Thanks to the security and increase in business the Federation brought to Kett Shipping, the Kett family were able to live well, purchasing interests on the worlds of Ma'ar Shaddam and [[Rseik]] and a [[Kett family retreat|retreat]] on the planet [[Z'trop]]. Findal Kett's great-great-great-grandson [[Firmus Kett]], who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Federation's [[Trade Defense Force]], spoke of the company's history in his memoirs. He admitted to feeling that Trade Federation control over the Rseik sector had grown to worrying levels by his lifetime, but considering what had happened before the Trade Federation came, he would never begrudge Findal Kett's decision.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kett Shipping was supposed to be first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2012]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], but they were ultimately cut from the final product. The section including the company was later published as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] starting in [[2013]].
